def _v3_fix_fcst_log_header():
    """Forecast-log surgery, idempotent. The v3.0.1 migration wrote the new
    8-col header ABOVE the old 4-col one instead of replacing it; the embedded
    old header parsed as a data row (later re-written with trailing commas by
    to_csv), poisoning blend/graded to object dtype — 'False'.astype(bool) is
    True, so update_calibration silently graded NOTHING. Drop every embedded
    header row and widen the top header."""
    try:
        if not os.path.exists(V3_FCST_LOG):
            return
        with open(V3_FCST_LOG) as f:
            lines = f.read().splitlines()
        if not lines:
            return
        hdr4 = "hour_et,blend,obs_f,graded"
        hdr8 = hdr4 + ",mean_f,model_mean_f,k_dir,mean_src"
        body = [l for l in lines[1:] if not l.strip().startswith("hour_et,")]
        top = hdr8 if lines[0].strip().startswith("hour_et,") and "," not in lines[0].strip()[len(hdr4):].strip(",").replace(",","") else lines[0]
        if lines[0].strip() == hdr4:
            top = hdr8
        if len(body) != len(lines) - 1 or top != lines[0]:
            with open(V3_FCST_LOG, "w") as f:
                f.write("\n".join([top] + body) + "\n")
            print("[v3] forecast log cleaned:", len(lines) - 1 - len(body), "embedded header row(s) removed")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[v3] header fix note (non-fatal): {e}")
